busBatteryWhy: Why the school sometimes loses the bus
busBatteryIntro:
While a trip is running, this phone sends its position to the school so the office and parents can see where the bus is. Most phones stop apps they think you are not using - and a phone in a cradle with its screen off looks exactly like an app nobody is using.

These two settings tell the phone this one is different. You only have to do it once.
busBatteryStep1Title: Allow it to run in the background
busBatteryStep1Body: This is the setting Android itself controls, and the button below opens it.
busBatteryStep2Title: Turn off your phone maker's battery saver for this app
busBatteryStep2Body: This one is not the same on every phone, and no app can change it for you. Find your make below.
busBatteryNotSure: If you are not sure which make your phone is, show this screen to your school office.
busMakeXiaomi1: Settings > Apps > Manage apps > School365ai Driver > Battery saver > No restrictions.

@busMakeXiaomi1.description: Settings path; menu names stay as the phone shows them in English.

busMakeXiaomi2: On the same screen, turn on Autostart.
busMakeXiaomi3: Open Recent apps, swipe down on this app's card and tap the padlock so it is not cleared.
busMakeOppo1: Settings > Battery > Power saving > App battery usage (or App battery management).
busMakeOppo2: Find School365ai Driver and choose Allow background activity, or Don't optimise.
busMakeOppo3: Turn on Allow auto launch for this app.
busMakeVivo1: Settings > Battery > Background power consumption management > School365ai Driver > Allow high background power consumption.
busMakeVivo2: Settings > Apps > Autostart, and turn it on for this app.
busMakeSamsung1: Settings > Apps > School365ai Driver > Battery > Unrestricted.
busMakeSamsung2: Settings > Battery > Background usage limits, and make sure this app is not in Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
busMakeOther1: Settings > Apps > School365ai Driver > Battery, and choose the least restricted option offered.
busMakeOther2: If there is an Autostart or Auto launch setting, turn it on.
